steps.title: Visit the Cockpit homepage
steps.narration: The Cockpit page shows the live price chart with candlestick data and a market tape panel that updates in real time.
steps.point_out: The chart renders candlesticks and the tape panel displays live bid, ask, and volume information from the simulated market feed.

steps.title: Navigate to the Structure page
steps.narration: The Structure page displays the Tradable Map chart and tools for comparing different datasets and strategy results.
steps.point_out: The Tradable Map shows support and resistance levels, and the Comparison panel below provides dataset selection and analysis tools.

steps.title: Open the Dataset dropdown in the Comparison panel
steps.narration: The dataset selector allows you to choose which recorded data to compare and analyze.
steps.point_out: The dropdown opens to reveal available datasets, each showing the symbol, data split type, and a unique identifier.

steps.title: View the Edge Report comparison results
steps.narration: The Edge Report displays a comparison of strategy results, or indicates if the analysis has not yet been computed.
steps.point_out: The panel shows either a table of comparison metrics or an honest 'Edge report not computed yet' message with a Compute button.

steps.title: Open the Desk page
steps.narration: The Desk page brings together multiple research sections, with Microscope Readiness showing your recorded tape datasets.
steps.point_out: The page contains various analysis panels; the Microscope Readiness section near the bottom displays recorded datasets with their metadata.

steps.title: Examine the Legacy Tick Shards table in Microscope Readiness
steps.narration: The shard table lists each recorded tape dataset with its symbol, date, checksum, and current status.
steps.point_out: Each row displays the Symbol, Session Date, Checksum, and exposure state (exploratory or sealed) for a recorded tape shard.

steps.title: Return to Cockpit and confirm navigation
steps.narration: The navigation bar connects all three main pages and properly highlights the active section.
steps.point_out: All navigation links (Cockpit, Structure, Desk) are responsive, and the active link highlights to show which page you are viewing.
